clue.text: Senior politician in torment if seat is unsafe

indicators.note: something unsafe is unsteady and liable to collapse, so these words fall apart and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A senior politician suffers agonies because the constituency could be lost at the next election.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsafe' is the anagram signal: rearrange TORMENTIFSEATIS. 'in' is only a link; a solver who includes it has one letter too many.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister of state is a middle-ranking government minister in Britain, just below cabinet rank.

clue.text: Keep track of warship

definitions.meaning: to watch over and record progress
a shallow-draught armoured gunship of the nineteenth century carried this name

explanation.definitionFit: To monitor something is to observe it continuously, and a monitor was also a class of low-lying warship.

clue.text: Silky fabric woven in one piece

indicators.note: a piece is a portion, so a portion of the words woven in one gives the answer

explanation.surface: A silk cloth woven as a single seamless length.
explanation.walkthrough: 'piece' signals a section of the run woveN IN ONe.
explanation.definitionFit: Ninon is a sheer lightweight silk or rayon dress material.

clue.text: Sport made of people falling down before opening time?

definitions.text: Sport made of people falling down before opening time?

parts.words: Sport made of people falling down before opening time?
parts.note: falling down before opening time suggests drunks before the pub opens, but really it is parachutists dropping through the air before the canopy opens

explanation.definitionFit: Free-fall parachuting is a sport in which jumpers drop before opening their chutes.

clue.text: Dress up as an Archbishop

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a robe is a dress or gown

explanation.surface: Someone dresses in vestments to look like an archbishop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is a link. Ebor is the signature of the Archbishop of York, from Eboracum, the Latin name of York.
explanation.definitionFit: The Archbishop of York signs himself by this Latin-derived abbreviation, so it stands for that prelate.

clue.text: How bounders are caught unawares?

parts.note: bounders are cads, but here they are creatures that bound or hop, caught in mid-leap; the idiom means taken by surprise

explanation.definitionFit: Being caught in mid-hop is an idiom for being surprised or unprepared.

clue.text: So a judge is supposed to appear in special robes

definitions.text: So a judge is supposed to appear

indicators.note: a special version is a modified one, so the letters of robes are reworked

explanation.surface: A judge should look as dignified as his ceremonial robes suggest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special' is the anagram signal on ROBES; 'in' is a link. The definition rests on the saying 'as ... as a judge'.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom says judges are proverbially temperate and clear-headed, never drunk.

clue.text: Land hole in one? Amazing start!

parts.note: an abyss is a deep hole or chasm
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A golfer achieves a hole in one and calls it an amazing start to the round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hole in one' looks like golf but splits into its pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Abyssinia is the former name of Ethiopia, a country or land.

clue.text: One coming down on the side of a deerstalker

definitions.text: One coming down on the side of a deerstalker

parts.words: One coming down on the side of a deerstalker
parts.note: coming down on the side of sounds like taking a side in an argument, but it is a flap of the hat that folds down over each ear

explanation.definitionFit: A deerstalker cap has a fold-down flap on each side to cover the wearer's ears.

clue.text: Butter and milk producer

parts.note: butter suggests a dairy product, but it means an animal that butts, and the female goat gives milk

explanation.definitionFit: A female goat butts with its head and is milked, so it is both a butter and a milk producer.

clue.text: Shop's agent or customer

definitions.meaning: a store employee who selects and purchases stock

explanation.definitionFit: A store's purchasing agent and any purchaser both carry this title.

clue.text: A real sport

parts.note: a real sport sounds like a good sort of person, but real here is part of the name of the old indoor court game played with rackets

explanation.definitionFit: Real tennis is the original indoor court game from which the lawn game developed.

clue.text: NATO ordered to abandon proletarians out for revenge

indicators.note: ordered means rearranged into a new sequence
to abandon means the letters of NATO are left behind and removed
out means disordered, signalling that the remaining letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Members of the working class, told to leave the alliance, are looking for vengeance.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove N, A, T and O from PROLETARIANS and rearrange the rest (PRLERIAS).
explanation.definitionFit: A reprisal is an act of retaliation, getting your own back for an injury.

clue.text: Kick, taking fresh wind into account?

parts.note: re- is the prefix meaning again or anew, so fresh gives it
to coil is to wind round in loops

explanation.surface: A footballer's kick has to allow for a fresh gust of wind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wind' looks like the breeze but is the verb to coil. 'Kick' is the jolt of a gun when fired.
explanation.definitionFit: The backward jerk of a fired gun is its kick.

clue.text: Type a letter …

definitions.meaning: a printed symbol or a sort of person
a single written symbol of the alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: Both a kind of person and a written symbol are called by this word.

clue.text: Cause of winter ailments needing little sleep

definitions.text: Cause of winter ailments needing little sleep

parts.note: colds are the common illnesses of winter
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: Seasonal illnesses leave sufferers needing a short rest.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines a sudden spell of frosty weather, while its tail builds the letters; 'needing' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden spell of freezing weather brings on sniffles and chills.

clue.text: … in French, having to observe strict etiquette

definitions.text: in French, having to observe strict etiquette

parts.words: in French, having to observe strict etiquette
parts.note: continuing the previous clue, the French phrase literally means of strictness and describes what custom requires

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this to 14 down, but the phrase is defined on its own: a French expression for what etiquette demands.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means required by fashion or custom, obligatory.

clue.text: Groundsuiting soft aquatic creature

indicators.note: suiting here means clothing, so the ground is dressed around the soft letter

parts.note: terrain is ground or land considered for its physical features
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, soft

explanation.surface: A soft-bodied water animal fits in well on dry land.
explanation.walkthrough: The page runs 'Ground' and 'suiting' together; read them apart. 'suiting' is not 'suitable' but 'clothing': the ground wraps round the soft letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A terrapin is a small freshwater turtle.

clue.text: Theatre attendant

parts.note: attendant suggests an usher or employee, but it means one who attends the theatre as audience

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who regularly attends drama performances is a member of the audience.

clue.text: Extra, cash needed for cover charge

definitions.meaning: an additional sum above the usual price
the regular payment made for insurance cover

explanation.definitionFit: Both a surcharge and an insurance payment go by this word.

clue.text: Chinese criminals organised raid in back-street

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other
back means the abbreviation for street is turned round
organised means put in order, so the letters of raid are rearranged

explanation.surface: Gangsters stage a carefully planned raid in a back alley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back-street' reads as one word but splits: 'back' reverses the street abbreviation, and 'in' puts the reorganised raid inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Triads are Chinese secret criminal societies.

clue.text: Like New York's irregular silhouette -

indicators.note: irregular means not in normal order, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: NY is the usual abbreviation for New York, and the possessive adds S

explanation.surface: Manhattan's jagged outline against the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irregular' scrambles LIKE with NYS; the dash leads into 22 down only for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The outline of buildings against the sky is a city's silhouette.

clue.text: As retired Thespians, they're very demanding

parts.note: ex- means former, as of someone retired from a post
thespians are actors, after Thespis, the founder of Greek drama

explanation.surface: Old actors who have left the stage are notoriously hard to please.
explanation.definitionFit: An exactor is one who insists on payment or extorts, so such people demand a great deal.

clue.text: — such as the superstructure of the Statue of Liberty?

definitions.text: such as the superstructure of the Statue of Liberty?

parts.words: such as the superstructure of the Statue of Liberty?
parts.note: the topmost part of the New York statue is the flaming light held aloft in her raised hand

explanation.walkthrough: The dash carries on from 20 down's New York scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberty holds a flame aloft at the very top of the statue.

clue.text: Means business

definitions.meaning: the method or instrumentality by which something is done
a firm providing a service, like an advertising firm

explanation.definitionFit: Both an instrumentality and a service company are called by this word.

clue.text: She's brought up one complaint

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the whole run is read from bottom to top

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a moan is a grumble or complaint

explanation.surface: A woman raises a single grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns the run I MOAN round as a whole; 's is 'has' as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi is a woman's name, Ruth's mother-in-law in the Bible.

clue.text: Work in the music business

parts.note: sounds like a job in the record industry, but it means a numbered musical composition

explanation.definitionFit: Composers' works are catalogued by number under this Latin word for a work.

clue.text: Bury having match with Italian team

definitions.meaning: to put a body in a grave

explanation.walkthrough: Bury is also an English football team, which makes the surface a fixture; 'having match with' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: To bury means to entomb, and the Milan football club is known by this short name.

clue.text: Sprinkle liberally over one topping for a pizza

parts.note: to pepper is to scatter thickly over something
on means over or upon
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A cook scatters plenty over the pizza's topping.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy sausage sliced on top of pizzas.

clue.text: Our main trading organisation

parts.note: main suggests chief, but it is the sea, so this is the nation's fleet of commercial ships

explanation.definitionFit: Britain's commercial shipping fleet is known as the merchant navy.
